hivemindAdaptations: Routes installation, browser authentication, package removal, and runtime registration through user-visible HivemindOS Integrations actions.
Pins the native MCP preview package to v0.8.0b1 and verifies the published wheel with a fixed SHA-256 digest.
Prefers the native 34-tool stdio MCP server, keeps full notebook IDs explicit for parallel safety, and limits CLI use to an installed fallback.
Removes direct pip, curl-to-shell, auth-file transfer, remote tunnel, and sandbox cookie-copy instructions from the default workflow.
Adds HivemindOS authority, destructive-action, outward-sharing, local-credential, source-content, and deliverable verification gates.

notes: Static scanning flagged destructive and remote-installer examples in upstream documentation; those examples are not included in the packaged HivemindOS skill.
The selected native MCP preview, CLI entrypoints, browser login flow, package metadata, and MIT license were manually reviewed at the pinned v0.8.0b1 commit.
The integration uses undocumented Google APIs and stores browser authentication in the upstream machine-local profile.
